title.narrative: India accelerated efforts to reduce anemia jointly with UNICEF's technical leadership. Under Anemia Mukt Bharat, 67 million adolescents and 23 million pregnant women received IFA supplements. Strong promotion  supported the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW) investment of USD 163 million and contributed to new MoHFW guidance on parenteral iron therapy, strengthening anemia treatment nationwide
